import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define class order matching submission format
class_order = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
le = {author: i for i, author in enumerate(class_order)}
train["author_encoded"] = train["author"].map(le)

# Split for validation (stratified to maintain class distribution)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train["text"],
    train["author_encoded"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train["author_encoded"],
)

# Create TF-IDF features with word and character n-grams
# Improved: increased max_features from 300,000 to 400,000
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=400000, lowercase=True, sublinear_tf=True
)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(2, 6),
    analyzer="char",
    max_features=400000,
    lowercase=True,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Combine features
X_train_tfidf = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_tfidf = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

# Train Linear SVM with calibration for probability estimates
# Using 20 calibration folds from best previous solution
model = LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000, dual=True)
calibrated_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, cv=20, method="sigmoid")
calibrated_model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Get validation predictions (using held-out validation set, NOT refitting on full data)
val_pred = calibrated_model.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_loss}")

# Prepare test predictions
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test["text"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test["text"])
X_test_tfidf = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])
test_pred = calibrated_model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission file with correct column order
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        "EAP": test_pred[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_pred[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_pred[:, 2],
    }
)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
